body:
Filing gate ①, class (a): published copy that contradicts a ruling. Found by the #24406 dev (report on #24406, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`); filed by `domain:spec` seat 1 (#6017) · `os-warren` · session `session_01WnW7HvfnfHbLg1fpkHX3Mu`. ⛔ Not a claim. Lane, grade and `area:*` are triage's: two files in two lanes, so triage splits or routes them.

**Reader who acts:** triage routes it. The client TSDoc is `domain:cli` (`packages/client`) and the docs row is `domain:devx` (`content/docs/**`, hand-written). Neither is in any per-lane card of this family.

## The sites (read on `origin/main` `9112bcd887`)

- `packages/client/src/index.ts:6702`: the TSDoc of `ai.models()`, "Models this environment offers in the chat model picker (ADR-0028) —". Published in `@objectstack/client`'s `.d.ts`.
- `content/docs/api/plugin-endpoints.mdx:112`: the `GET /ai/models` row, "Models this environment offers (ADR-0028)". Hand-written (listed in `scripts/docs-audit/handwritten-docs.json`) and served on the docs site.

## Why now

PR #24454 (#24406) moves the source of both sentences, `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts:3373`, to "Models this system offers", per objectstack-ai/cloud#3002 ruling A as triage applied it (`6250167038`, `6252585695`). Until these two follow, the client and the docs page say the old word beside the spec's new one.

## The rule (as on the family's cards)

- "made here, not from a package" reads "authored in this system";
- "the system the caller is in" drops the noun, or says "this system";
- a string that means a deployment or configuration scope keeps its word.

## Also seen, for the reader (not this card's scope)

- The same TSDoc and docs row cite a bare `ADR-0028`. This registry's ADR-0028 is metadata naming, so the cited record is probably cloud's (AGENTS.md Prime Directive #13: cite it as `cloud ADR-NNNN`). That is the #24406 dev's reading; it is not re-measured here.

## Dedupe

- `search_issues` on objectstack, "client ai.models TSDoc plugin-endpoints models this environment offers this system": 0 hits.
- Control: "platform copy this environment strings cloud#3002 ruling A" → 11 hits, the whole family (#24406, #24368, #24327, #24405, #24404, #24360, …). The family's cards name `cloud-connection`, `plugin-auth`, `service-settings`, `platform-objects`, `mcp`, `plugin-security` and `spec`, and none names `packages/client` or `content/docs/api`.

Dedupe words: client ai.models TSDoc this environment; plugin-endpoints ai/models this environment offers; cloud#3002 ruling A client docs remainder.
